questions.question: A water cooler holds 20 litres. How many 200 ml cups can it fill? Show your working.
questions.expected_answer: 20 litres is 20 000 ml. 20 000 ml divided by 200 ml is 100, so the cooler fills 100 cups.

questions.question: Find the median and the mode of the sack race times 14, 18, 12, 15, 18, 20 and 16 seconds.
questions.expected_answer: In order the times are 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 18, 20. The median is the fourth value, 16 seconds. The mode is 18 seconds, because it appears twice.

questions.question: The fun day raised R12 485 and cost R4 790. Find the profit and check your answer.
questions.expected_answer: The profit is R12 485 minus R4 790, which is R7 695. Check: R7 695 plus R4 790 is R12 485.
